display_long_description:
The moles are back and they brought friends.

You stand in the middle of the stand with a mallet in each hand. In front of you, a table and two rows of windows. To your left and right, the walls. Over your head, the ceiling. Twenty-seven holes in total, and everything within arm's reach: no teleporting, no thumbstick, no menus to aim at. You swing, you hit.

WHAT YOU PLAY
- 18 hand-tuned missions of one minute each, plus an endless Legend mode.
- Every mission opens a new front: level 1, then level 2 and 3, then the side walls, then the ceiling.
- The target of each mission is calculated from how many moles will actually pop up, so it is always demanding and never impossible.

WHO POPS UP
- Golden moles: triple points, but they duck fast.
- Bombs: do NOT hit them. One bomb costs you a hit and breaks your streak.
- Armored moles: two solid whacks and double points.
- Streaks: five hits in a row and your points multiply, up to four times.
